title: Customer Audit Request Portal: data residency, retention controls, and evidence automation
creator: Marisol Vega
description:
Problem statement: Customers repeatedly ask for a single-pane experience to submit compliance/audit requests (questionnaires, DPA evidence, site-residency proofs) and receive exportable, time-stamped bundles. Today support engineers stitch artifacts manually: logs, export snapshots, contract excerpts, and retention configs. This is slow and error-prone, and blocks larger enterprise deals.

Goal: Ship a Customer Audit Request Portal (CARP) in the Console that lets customers: 1) create a formal audit request, 2) attach scope (projects, model endpoints, regions), 3) provide preferred data residency and retention settings for the request, 4) trigger automated evidence collection (questionnaire templates, system configuration exports, audit logs), and 5) download a signed bundle or invite Redwood compliance to review. The flow should be auditable, produce machine-readable evidence, and integrate with DPA templates.

Key user stories: 
- As a security/compliance contact, I can open a new audit request and scope which projects, models, or datasets are in-scope so evidence is scoped correctly.
- As a legal contact, I can select a DPA clause template and request contract excerpts for specific regions where data is processed.
- As an ops lead, I can set temporary retention overrides for a request (e.g., extend logs retention to 90 days for the scope) and have the system revert the change on a schedule.
- As a customer reviewer, I receive an automatically compiled evidence bundle (JSON manifest + PDFs + signed timestamps) with a verification checksum and index.

Non-goals: Not replacing full legal negotiation of DPAs; not building a public-facing SOC report delivery pipeline in this phase.

UX/console surfaces: 
- New Console section: Compliance » Audit Requests with a request list, status (Draft, Submitted, In Review, Evidence Ready, Closed), and request timeline.
- Request builder wizard: scope selector (projects/endpoints), residency selector (regions to include/exclude), retention override toggles with safe-guard tooltips, and questionnaire templates (pre-populated).
- Evidence bundle viewer: preview of included files with signed timestamps and a downloadable .zip/.tar.gz with manifest.json.

API surfaces: 
- POST /v1/compliance/requests to create requests programmatically.
- GET /v1/compliance/requests/:id to get status and manifest URL.
- POST /v1/compliance/requests/:id/actions/collect to trigger evidence collection (for advanced uses).
- Export manifests are machine-readable (JSON) and include sha256 checksums for each artifact.

Automation rules and retention controls: 
- Temporary retention overrides implemented as timeboxed policies attached to the request; these modify retention at the tenant-resource level via existing retention APIs and are automatically revoked at expiry.
- Data residency filter: evidence collection respects region scoping (only gathers artifacts from permitted regions) and marks items excluded for residency reasons in the manifest.

Evidence catalogue (minimum): 
- Audit logs (time-bounded, filtered by scope) including signing metadata
- Configuration snapshot: model versions, runtime config, KV cache settings, quantization profiles in use
- Network & access logs for the scope (S3/Blob export pointers if large)
- DPA contract excerpts and signed attachments (from legal repo)
- Questionnaire answers (templated + free-text) and reviewer notes

Questionnaire templates: 
- Standard enterprise questionnaire (mapped to ISO controls we track), legal/DPA checklist, and a short engineering evidence checklist for runtime settings. Templates must be editable per-customer and versioned.
Acceptance criteria: Customers can create and submit a scoped audit request via the Console
System generates an evidence bundle with manifest and downloadable archive within SLA (target: 4 hours for medium scope)
Retention overrides are applied and revoked automatically and logged
Exported bundle includes residency-aware exclusion flags and checksums
API endpoints exist and are documented in the public API docs
Questionnaire templates are editable by Redwood admins and saved as versioned artifacts
tasks: PM: finalize scope, templates, and acceptance criteria
Design: wireframes for Audit Request wizard + bundle viewer
ENG: implement API endpoints and retention override mechanism
ENG: build evidence collector worker with residency filters and manifest generator
ENG: integrate with legal repo for DPA excerpt fetching
SEC/LEGAL: review questionnaire templates and automated DPA excerpts
DX: write Console help text and admin docs
SRE: ensure collection worker scales and add monitoring/alerts
metrics: Percentage of requests resolved without manual support
Number of enterprise contracts closed citing self-serve audit tooling
Error rate for evidence collection jobs
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Over-permissioning retention overrides -> Mitigation: require 2-person approval for scopes impacting >=100TB
Risk: Large exports cause S3/egress cost spikes -> Mitigation: provide signed pointers and configurable sampling, and surface cost estimate before submission
Risk: Residual PII in configs -> Mitigation: scrub sensitive fields with opt-in redaction and require customer approval for raw exports
notes: Deliverable should be backwards-compatible with existing manual support flows: support can still create and download bundles. We will pilot with three enterprise customers in Q2 before broad release. Consider future extensions: SOC-ready scheduled bundle exports, webhooks to CI systems, and RBAC per-organization compliance delegates.
